description: Al-Noor Sugar Mills Limited is a Pakistani agro-industrial company founded in 1969 that has grown beyond sugar milling into a diversified business: sugar remains central, and the company also produces MDF board under the Lasani brand and generates power. It is part of the Al-Noor group and describes itself as playing a role in Pakistan's agro-industrial economy.
